evidence.passage: The PDF abstract and Table5 identify a single continuous/online study with multiple decoding settings. Reference [6] is Takayama et al. (10.5220/0010899400003124); [8] is Buttar et al. (10.3390/math11173729). The previously noted inconsistent study counts remain unresolved.

Takayama and colleagues evaluate skeleton-based online continuous word recognition using monotonic attention on isolated-word and sentence videos. The abstract confirms this study's CSLR task; it does not establish a second distinct study in the review.
